Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Alright, I just got back from a Sabbat/Sabbat War
sealed deck tournament, up here in Boston.
3VP, not bad for my first tourney...

But anyway.. the question of Alvaro came up, and how
his "abstaining" ability works.

That is.. what constitutes "abstaining from a vote"?
There was an attempt to Excommunicate him (which failed),
but we asked what would happen to his special ability.
Our judge ruled that, if Alvaro lost his title, and
did not have voting rights, then he could not gain the
two blood by "not voting". But I seem to remember reading
a ruling that he _could_ gain this blood, much the same
as Gratiano still gets his +1 Priscus vote.

What's the official word, LSJ?

And what if Alvaro is in Torpor? Does he gain blood during
votes then?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> Alright, I just got back from a Sabbat/Sabbat War
> sealed deck tournament, up here in Boston.
> 3VP, not bad for my first tourney...
>
> But anyway.. the question of Alvaro came up, and how
> his "abstaining" ability works.
>
> That is.. what constitutes "abstaining from a vote"?

Not voting. A vampire either casts a vote(s) in the referendum
(for or against) or he abstains.

> There was an attempt to Excommunicate him (which failed),
> but we asked what would happen to his special ability.
> Our judge ruled that, if Alvaro lost his title, and
> did not have voting rights, then he could not gain the
> two blood by "not voting". But I seem to remember reading
> a ruling that he _could_ gain this blood, much the same
> as Gratiano still gets his +1 Priscus vote.
>
> What's the official word, LSJ?

He gets his blood if he doesn't cast any votes, even if he
doesn't have a title any more.

> And what if Alvaro is in Torpor? Does he gain blood during
> votes then?

Yes.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
> What if a Banishment is called on Alvaro, does he gain blood before becoming
> uncontrolled?

No. He gains the blood "at the end of the action", by which time he is
uncontrolled (and so he gains no blood).

Alvaro, like every other vampire, either votes or abstains. There is no
third option. If he doesn't vote, he abstains. If he votes (either in
favor or against), he doesn't abstain.
